scope_clarification: Selected European economies only. National mortgage laws, property taxes, and notary systems vary substantially by sovereign member state and cannot be modeled as a single uniform Eurozone regime.

transfer_tax_grunderwerbsteuer.description: Levied at state (Bundesland) level: 3.5% in Bavaria, up to 6.5% in NRW, Brandenburg, and Saarland

notary_and_land_registry.description: Statutory fees under GNotKG (Gerichts- und Notarkostengesetz)

closing_costs.total_cash_closing_costs: 7.0% – 12.0% (must be provided upfront in equity; cannot be rolled into mortgage)

underwriting_standards.repayment_structure: Baufinanzierung with fixed interest rate (Sollzins) for 10–20 years and agreed initial principal repayment (Tilgung, typically 1.5% – 3.0%)

frais_de_notaire_existing_property.description: Transfer duties (droits de mutation) and notary fees for existing residential property

frais_de_notaire_new_build.description: Reduced notary fees for VEFA / newly constructed homes (subject to 20% VAT)

hcsf_debt_service_cap.description: Legally binding cap limiting total housing debt payments (taux d'effort) to a maximum 35% of net household income, with a maximum 25-year amortization (extended to 27 years for new build/major work).

transfer_tax_itp.description: Impuesto sobre Transmisiones Patrimoniales (ITP) for resale property, set by Autonomous Community (e.g., Madrid 6%, Catalonia 10%, Andalucia 7%)

notary_and_registry.description: Notary and land registry statutory fees

underwriting_standards.variable_mortgage_index: 12-month Euribor benchmark plus bank spread (Hipoteca variable)

imposta_di_registro_prima_casa.description: 2% registration tax for primary residence (prima casa) purchased from a private seller

imposta_di_registro_seconda_casa.description: 9% registration tax for secondary residence or non-resident purchase

notary_fees.description: Notary and technical cadastre deed fees

overdrachtsbelasting_standard.description: 2% transfer tax for owner-occupier primary residence

overdrachtsbelasting_starter_exemption.description: 0% transfer tax for buyers aged 18–34 purchasing their primary residence up to the statutory statutory value limit

overdrachtsbelasting_investor.description: 10.4% transfer tax for buy-to-let, holiday, and non-owner-occupied investments

notary_and_kadaster.description: Notary conveyance and mortgage deed registration
